summary: SK hynix Inc., a Korean semiconductor issuer listed via ADR/foreign private issuer status, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a voluntary current report) announcing only a conference call for its 2026 third-quarter earnings results, scheduled for October 28, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Seoul time. The call covers earnings results plus a Q&A session for investors and press, with simultaneous Korean/English webcast and archived materials posted to the company's IR website. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; this is a routine earnings-notice filing with no special-situations or risk-arb angle.
